designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system is built for dense data exploration, financial modeling, and analytical workflows. It embodies a clean, spreadsheet-classic aesthetic that prioritizes absolute clarity, high contrast, and zero platform chrome discrepancies. The design style relies on a functional, flat presentation with strict structural grids, ensuring a calm, professional, and reliable environment for long data-heavy sessions.

D
## Layout & Spacing

The layout model follows a structured, fixed-grid spreadsheet architecture where content aligns to precise rows and columns. Spacing is tight and predictable to maximize information density. Gutters and component paddings rely on an incremental spacing scale designed to keep toolbar elements, data cells, and inspector panels systematically aligned.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy is achieved primarily through a flat architectural layout utilizing precise hairlines and background tonal shifts rather than dramatic shadows or blurs. Surfaces are demarcated by clean 1px borders (`#e1e4e8` and `#c9ced6`). Floating menus, contextual dialogs, and popovers are the sole elements permitted to break flatness, using a single soft, diffused shadow (`0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)`).

## Components

### Toolbar
Constructed with icon-above-label buttons, exactly 64px wide. Grouped logically and separated by thin vertical hairlines (`#e1e4e8`). Hover states fill with the raised surface color (`#f0f2f5`), and active tools take on the primary accent tint.

### Data Grid
The core data component featuring a 48px row-number gutter, column header rows complete with type badges (`#`, `$`, `Aa`, calendar), and tiny distribution histograms. Body rows maintain a strict 28px height with hairline borders. Selected cells display a 2px accent ring, selected columns are lightly tinted (`#e3f2f3`), and formula columns render their evaluated values in the designated formula color.

### Formula Bar
Composed of a cell reference indicator box, a distinct "fx" label, a monospace input field, and immediate cancel/accept action buttons.

### Inspector Panel
A fixed 300px right-side panel featuring top-level navigation tabs, small uppercase section titles, flat dropdown menus, segmented controls, steppers, and switches.

### Sheet Tabs
Positioned at the bottom-left in classic spreadsheet fashion. Flat rectangular tabs where the active tab rests on the surface background with a 2px accent top edge, accompanied by an inline creation button.

### Status Bar
A fixed 26px footer using monospace figures to display total rows, active selection summaries (sum, average, count), GPU status, and last computation time.

### KPI Cards
Structured with a clear text label, a prominent monospace numeric figure, an inline sparkline visualization, and a semantic delta chip reflecting good or bad conditional styling.

screens.prompt:
A desktop application window for 'omxplorer', a spreadsheet app for data scientists (1440x900 viewport). Strict adherence to Ledger / Spreadsheet Classic specifications in DESIGN.md.

Window Chrome & Structure:
- App Window chrome (#f5f6f8 background, subtle window controls on left like macOS/desktop or clean title bar).
- Top Title bar: lowercase 'omxplorer' on the left, centered document title 'orders.omx', right-aligned subtle actions.
- Toolbar: icon-above-label buttons (64px wide, height ~52px) grouped by thin vertical hairlines (#e1e4e8):
  - Group 1: [Open, Save, Undo, Redo]
  - Group 2: [Table, Chart, Pivot, Formula]
  - Group 3: [KPI, Chart tile, Text]
  - Group 4: [Format]
  Clean Lucide line icons (1.5px stroke, 18px), 11px toolbar labels in Inter. Active tool has accent tint (#e3f2f3 background, #0e7c86 text).

Main Work Area:
- Background behind the sheet / page: calm grey #eef0f3.
- Work area is split into:
  1. Main Canvas Area (scrollable, centered white report page sheet with subtle soft shadow or crisp hairline border).
  2. Right-docked Inspector Panel (300px fixed width, #ffffff background, border-left #e1e4e8):
     - Tabs at top: 'Tile · Data' with 'Tile' tab active (highlighted with #0e7c86 accent border/tint).
     - Section for Selected Tile ('Revenue' KPI card selected):
       - Small uppercase section title: 'DATA BINDING'
       - Value column dropdown: select input showing 'revenue'
       - Aggregate segmented control: 3 segments [Sum | Average | Count] with 'Sum' active in accent/raised state
       - Compare-to dropdown: select input showing 'previous quarter'
       - Small uppercase section title: 'DISPLAY FORMAT'
       - Currency format, decimals (2), show sparkline toggle (checked/active).
       - Monospace details: 'Source: orders.omx [Col C] · Computed in 0.4ms'.

Report Page (white #ffffff sheet, max-width ~960px or centered in workspace, padding 32px, rounded-md 6px):
- Header:
  - Title: 'Q3 orders' (20px font-bold #1b1f24)
  - Caption: 'Updated just now · 1,000,000 rows · 4.1 ms on the GPU' (12px secondary #6b7380, with JetBrains Mono numbers)
- Filter Chips row:
  - 'region = West ✕' (chip with badge style, #e3f2f3 bg, #0e7c86 text, 4px radius)
  - 'date: Jul–Sep 2026 ✕' (chip with badge style, #f0f2f5 bg, #1b1f24 text)
  - 'carrier: all' (chip, subtle border)
  - '+ Filter' (dashed or ghost chip button)
- KPI Cards row (4 cards in a grid, #ffffff cards, 6px radius, border #e1e4e8, p-4):
  - Card 1 (SELECTED with 2px accent #0e7c86 ring and subtle #e3f2f3 tint):
    - Label: 'Revenue'
    - Big figure: '$18.4M' (JetBrains Mono tabular, bold, 24px)
    - Sparkline graph (smooth SVG curve in #0e7c86)
    - Delta chip: '+4.2%' (#1f8a4c good green bg/text)
  - Card 2:
    - Label: 'Orders'
    - Big figure: '255,102' (JetBrains Mono)
    - Delta chip: '+1.1%' (#1f8a4c)
  - Card 3:
    - Label: 'Average order'
    - Big figure: '$72.06' (JetBrains Mono)
    - Delta chip: '-0.8%' (#c8364c bad red)
  - Card 4:
    - Label: 'Margin'
    - Big figure: '31.4%' (JetBrains Mono)
    - Delta chip: '+0.6 pts' (#1f8a4c)
- Two Charts side-by-side (2-column grid, #ffffff panels, border #e1e4e8, p-4, 6px radius):
  - Chart 1: 'Revenue by month'
    - Line chart (Jan to Sep) using accent #0e7c86 line with light area fill or crisp vector path, thin gridlines (#e1e4e8).
    - Visible hover tooltip/callout over August point: 'Aug · $6.3M' (dark pill with JetBrains Mono font).
  - Chart 2: 'Revenue by carrier'
    - Horizontal bar chart with categories UPS ($7.8M), FedEx ($5.4M), DHL ($3.1M), USPS ($2.1M).
    - Bars in color series (#0e7c86, #e8833a, #5b5fc7, #d6455d) with right-aligned tabular monospace values.
- Pivot Table: 'Revenue · region × product'
  - Data table with row-number gutter or row headers, 5 product columns (Hardware, Enterprise, Cloud, Peripherals, Support), and Row Total & Column Totals.
  - Cell values right-aligned JetBrains Mono, formatted as currency ($4,230,190, etc.).
  - Hairlines between cells (#e1e4e8), raised header row (#f0f2f5), bold totals.
- Empty dashed tile:
  - Border-dashed 2px border #c9ced6, rounded 6px, p-4 flex items-center justify-between text-secondary:
  - Text: 'Add a tile'
  - Buttons: [Sum] [Average] [Count] [Chart] (small flat buttons, 4px radius)

Bottom Bar & Sheet Tabs:
- Fixed at bottom: Sheet tabs along bottom-left:
  - Tab 'Orders' (#f0f2f5 bg, quiet text)
  - Tab 'Report' (ACTIVE, #ffffff bg, 2px #0e7c86 top border, dark bold text)
  - '+' button for new sheet
- Status bar on bottom-right / spanning bar (height 26px, bg #f5f6f8, border-t #e1e4e8):
  - 'Filtered: 255,102 of 1,000,000 rows · GPU: Apple M3 Max · 4.1 ms' in JetBrains Mono 11px.

Color scheme strictly matching Ledger: Accent #0e7c86, Surface #ffffff, Chrome #f5f6f8, Raised #f0f2f5, Hairline #e1e4e8, Ink #1b1f24, Body #3d434c, Good #1f8a4c, Bad #c8364c. JetBrains Mono for all numbers and code. Inter for UI.

outputComponents.text:
I have created the desktop interface for **omxplorer (1440×900)** on its **Report tab**, strictly adhering to the **Ledger** design specification:

### Key Highlights & Features:
1. **Window Chrome & Toolbar**:
   - Lowercase `omxplorer` logo on top-left, centered document filename `orders.omx` (with Parquet badge), and query/export actions on the right.
   - 64px icon-above-label toolbar categorized into `[Open, Save, Undo, Redo]`, `[Table, Chart, Pivot, Formula]`, `[KPI, Chart tile, Text]`, and `[Format]` with 18px line icons and 11px Inter labels.
2. **Centered Report Document**:
   - Clean white page sheet mounted on a quiet grey `#eef0f3` canvas.
   - Header with `"Q3 orders"` title and metadata caption: *"Updated just now · 1,000,000 rows · 4.1 ms on the GPU"*.
   - Filter chips: `region = West ✕` (active teal badge), `date: Jul–Sep 2026 ✕`, `carrier: all`, and `+ Filter`.
3. **KPI Cards & Selection**:
   - 4-card metric row featuring **Revenue $18.4M** (+4.2%, sparkline, selected with the 2px `#0e7c86` accent ring), **Orders 255,102** (+1.1%), **Average order $72.06** (-0.8%), and **Margin 31.4%** (+0.6 pts).
   - Formatted using tabular **JetBrains Mono** and good/bad delta indicators (`#1f8a4c` and `#c8364c`).
4. **Interactive Visualizations**:
   - **Revenue by month**: Clean line chart with thin hairlines and an active hover tooltip pill at `Aug · $6.3M`.
   - **Revenue by carrier**: Color-blind safe horizontal bars for UPS, FedEx, DHL, and USPS with right-aligned tabular figures.
5. **Pivot Table & Add Tile**:
   - `"Revenue · region × product"` pivot grid with 5 product columns, raised `#f0f2f5` headers, formatted currency values, and row/column totals.
   - Dashed `"Add a tile"` slot with quick action buttons (`Sum`, `Average`, `Count`, `Chart`).
6. **300px Inspector & Status Bar**:
   - Right-side panel with `"Tile · Data"` tabs (`Tile` active), showing Data Binding configurations for the selected Revenue card (column dropdown, Sum/Avg/Count segmented control, comparison dropdown, sparkline toggle, and DuckDB provenance timing).
   - Bottom sheet tabs featuring inactive `"Orders"` and active `"Report"` (accent top edge) with full GPU status readout (*"Filtered: 255,102 of 1,000,000 rows | GPU: Apple M3 Max · 4.1 ms"*).

outputComponents.suggestion: Switch to the 'Orders' sheet tab to view the 1,000,000-row raw data grid
Add a dark mode version of the omxplorer interface
Expand the Inspector panel with advanced pivot table configuration

Positioned at the bottom-left in classic spreadsheet fashion. Flat rectangular tabs where the active tab rests on the surface background with a 2px accent top edge, accompanied by an inline creation button.

### Status Bar
A fixed 26px footer using monospace figures to display total rows, active selection summaries (sum, average, count), GPU status, and last computation time.

### KPI Cards
Structured with a clear text label, a prominent monospace numeric figure, an inline sparkline visualization, and a semantic delta chip reflecting good or bad conditional styling.

rawScreen.agentText:
I have created the desktop interface for **omxplorer (1440×900)** on its **Report tab**, strictly adhering to the **Ledger** design specification:

### Key Highlights & Features:
1. **Window Chrome & Toolbar**:
   - Lowercase `omxplorer` logo on top-left, centered document filename `orders.omx` (with Parquet badge), and query/export actions on the right.
   - 64px icon-above-label toolbar categorized into `[Open, Save, Undo, Redo]`, `[Table, Chart, Pivot, Formula]`, `[KPI, Chart tile, Text]`, and `[Format]` with 18px line icons and 11px Inter labels.
2. **Centered Report Document**:
   - Clean white page sheet mounted on a quiet grey `#eef0f3` canvas.
   - Header with `"Q3 orders"` title and metadata caption: *"Updated just now · 1,000,000 rows · 4.1 ms on the GPU"*.
   - Filter chips: `region = West ✕` (active teal badge), `date: Jul–Sep 2026 ✕`, `carrier: all`, and `+ Filter`.
3. **KPI Cards & Selection**:
   - 4-card metric row featuring **Revenue $18.4M** (+4.2%, sparkline, selected with the 2px `#0e7c86` accent ring), **Orders 255,102** (+1.1%), **Average order $72.06** (-0.8%), and **Margin 31.4%** (+0.6 pts).
   - Formatted using tabular **JetBrains Mono** and good/bad delta indicators (`#1f8a4c` and `#c8364c`).
4. **Interactive Visualizations**:
   - **Revenue by month**: Clean line chart with thin hairlines and an active hover tooltip pill at `Aug · $6.3M`.
   - **Revenue by carrier**: Color-blind safe horizontal bars for UPS, FedEx, DHL, and USPS with right-aligned tabular figures.
5. **Pivot Table & Add Tile**:
   - `"Revenue · region × product"` pivot grid with 5 product columns, raised `#f0f2f5` headers, formatted currency values, and row/column totals.
   - Dashed `"Add a tile"` slot with quick action buttons (`Sum`, `Average`, `Count`, `Chart`).
6. **300px Inspector & Status Bar**:
   - Right-side panel with `"Tile · Data"` tabs (`Tile` active), showing Data Binding configurations for the selected Revenue card (column dropdown, Sum/Avg/Count segmented control, comparison dropdown, sparkline toggle, and DuckDB provenance timing).
   - Bottom sheet tabs featuring inactive `"Orders"` and active `"Report"` (accent top edge) with full GPU status readout (*"Filtered: 255,102 of 1,000,000 rows | GPU: Apple M3 Max · 4.1 ms"*).
